summary: Los Angeles County lookout on Charlie (Castaic) Peak: CCC-built tower 1934, county-staffed 1965, closed 1971; listed gone; site today undocumented.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Fire Lookout Association; no source gives the year it came down or what, if anything, remains

staffing.status: staffed by the county forestry department from 1965; closed 1971

events.note: Forest Lookouts: tower erected by the Civilian Conservation Corps
Forest Lookouts says the county staffed it when Castaic Reservoir was filled; Wikipedia dates completion of Castaic Dam to 1973, so the date is disputed
Closed September 1 for lack of funding, smog and better communications

evidence.supports: tower erected by the Civilian Conservation Corps in 1934
evidence.quote: 1934: Tower erected by the Civilian Conservation Corps

evidence.supports: county forestry staffed the lookout in 1965; opening tied to reservoir filling
evidence.quote: 1965: The Los Angeles County Forestry Department staffed the lookout that was opened when the Castaic Reservoir was filled.

evidence.supports: required by the US Forest Service and funded by the state water agency
evidence.quote: The lookout was required by the U.S. Forest Service and funded by the State Water Resources.

evidence.supports: closed 1971 for lack of funding, smog and communications
evidence.quote: September 1, 1971: The lookout was closed because of lack of funding, problems with smog and better communications.

evidence.supports: listed in Los Angeles County as a tower, now gone
evidence.quote: Charlie Peak Los Angeles 34.51726 -118.59245 Tower Gone

evidence.supports: Castaic Dam construction completed in 1973, bearing on the 1965 reservoir link

notes_for_editor: Staffing date conflict is unresolved: Forest Lookouts ties the 1965 staffing to the reservoir being filled, while Wikipedia dates Castaic Dam completion to 1973. The story reports both. No access level appears in any source, so the access key is omitted (brief says unknown). The Fire Lookout Association list gives no removal date. The brief record (name, county, coordinates, tower, gone, agency) matches the sources; no corrections. No photos found. An Angeles Adventures page also lists Charlie/Castaic Peak, but its section heading was not checked, so it is not cited.
